name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company
observables_to_research: quarterly revenue and gross-margin guidance against the prior guide
revenue share by technology node and by platform
ADR premium to the ordinary shares

exposures.mechanism_hypothesis: Revenue is mostly in US dollars and costs in Taiwan dollars, and the ADR is priced off the Taiwan line, so TWD moves change margins and the ADR premium
Taiwan power, water and overseas-investment policy apply to it directly, and cross-strait risk is priced into it first
US subsidy terms and tariff treatment of Taiwan-made chips change the cost of its US build-out
Export rules decide which China customers it may serve and at which nodes
